QuestInfo.name: Chaos in the Center
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bPiston#k in the City Center for your next mission.
QuestInfo.1: The city is still in chaos. Meet #bTiron#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k and help him secure the area.
QuestInfo.2: You met Tiron in the Downtown Black Market.

0.0: They say you gave the enemy a black eye or ten in the last fight. I could use a soldier with your spunk. It's good to be back in the middle of the action!\r\n
0.1: The fighting isn't done yet. There's still plenty of enemy combatants slinking through the shadows, waiting for an opportunity to strike.\r\n
0.2: I say we don't give them the chance. My soldiers are patrolling the area to keep things nice and safe, but you... you're more the 'charge into battle screaming' type, aren't you?\r\n

yes.0: That's the spirit! I'll leave cleaning up the rabble in the city center to you. Ah, I'd better give you more direction than that...\r\n
yes.1: Captain Tiron will accompany you. Ask him for the details. Captain #bTiron#k is at the #bDowntown Black Market#k.\r\n

no.0: You have something better to do?\r\n

1.0: Ah, it's been a while. Piston said you'd be working with me.\r\n

yes.0: So, our job is to wipe out the rest of the enemies. That... that shouldn't be too hard, right?\r\n
yes.1: I'll scout things out. You... you take care of all the violent parts.\r\n
yes.2: Anyway, we're covering the western districts, including the Heliseum Downtown Center. That place is crawling with bad guys...\r\n
yes.3: Let's do this, I guess! To the #bHeliseum Downtown Center#k!\r\n#r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k
